cards.description: Typography-aware text-to-image with clean, legible text rendering.
principles: prompt is required — an empty/whitespace prompt is rejected loud, never sampled with empty conditioning
The negative channel is the zeroed conditioning (ConditioningZeroOut) — the official family graph has no negative text input
mu/std ride the model defaults (merged at serve time); the universal form does not carry them as fields
Sampler option lists resolve from the ONE vocabulary — never hand-copied

cards.label: Image Edit
cards.description: Instruction-driven image editing — the edit_image interface card boarding the Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 lane; the family carries the lightning / standard cascade (variant/quant always shown) plus the lanpaint flavor (required anchor image). The surface scopes itself.
principles: input_image is required — the edit is anchored on it (the lanpaint flavor declares it; input_param: input_artifact, slots image1..image3)
Qwen-Image-Edit uses low CFG (flow-matching) — the Guidance Scale slider tops out at 10.0
A lanpaint_mask alongside input_image patches the model with the DiffSynth inpaint ControlNet
Region Mode controls how the mask is honored: auto / crop_stitch / full_frame
Mask prep (grow/feather/threshold/invert) uses the same host-side chain the Inpaint card uses
Iterate HERE, not in video — an edit costs seconds, a render minutes; name what changes, state the rest as unchanged

Previous card outputs ride as artifact URLs (/v1/assets/runs/<run>/<file>); the compose resolves them to data/runs/output/<run>/<file> and stages into the comfy input dir (phase 1 validates on the mounts BEFORE registration)

cards.label: Image
cards.description: Text-to-image generation — the generate_image interface card boarding krea-2; the family declares its mods (loras) and the surface scopes itself
principles: prompt is required — an empty/whitespace prompt is rejected loud, never sampled with empty conditioning
Defaults are shape, not value: resolution/steps/cfg come from the model folder (defaults:/presets), merged at serve time
Sampler and scheduler option lists resolve from the ONE vocabulary (media.comfyui.sampler_vocab) — never hand-copied
A preset fills untouched fields; values you have set win

Mods are model-level declarations: lanpaint rides the families that declare it (anima, z-image) — input_image + lanpaint_mask switch the builder to LanPaintKSampler; loras ride krea-2 (apply on Turbo, train on Raw)
Mask prep (grow/feather/threshold/invert) and outpaint pads are applied host-side before the run — no silent param drops

cards.label: Upscale Tools
cards.description: Diffusion upscale (SeedVR2-3B fp16) — the hidden tool card; also home of the consumed tool fragments (resize, pixel-upscale, rtx-vsr, concat, input)
principles: A tool lane boards only with real weight facts — the weightless fragments render as consumed arms, never as phantom submit options
SeedVR2 restores detail (diffusion); plain resize resamples pixels — pick by intent, not by size
resolution is the TARGET short side (1080 = FHD rail); max_resolution is the hard ceiling the lane refuses past
Defaults are shape, not value: filenames and knobs come from the model folder, merged at serve time
rtx-vsr is NVIDIA-SDK-only: the arm is compose-truth, execution needs the RTX stack

cards.label: H3 Timeline
cards.description: THE video interface — multi-window film with SLA sparse attention, joint video+audio per window, auto-stitched into one mp4. The calls document IS the timeline.
principles: Describe MOTION and SOUND together — H3 generates both in one pass
Draft at 768x448x56f (~2.3s); produce at 1344x768x124f (~5.2s)
Length snaps to the 17k+5 frame grid at 24fps
For timelines: repeat the ambient soundscape verbatim in every window; add one new layer where the story needs it
Same seed across a shot's re-rolls keeps the world texture
SLA at sparsity 0.90 gives ~1.75x speedup with no quality loss — use it by default

cards.label: Video
cards.description: Text/reference-to-video — the generate_video interface card boarding wan-vace and scail2-animate; one surface, one arm per family
principles: prompt is required — an empty/whitespace prompt is rejected loud, never sampled with empty conditioning
The reference image anchors identity/scene — prompt the MOTION, not the subject
Wan frames are 4n+1 (49 ≈ 2s at 24fps); SCAIL-2 drives a character from a pose video
Defaults are shape, not value: resolution/steps/cfg come from the model folder, merged at serve time
A family boards only when it can feed truthfully — lane facts + the arm template, no phantom options

cards.label: Creature Forge
cards.description: Breed a creature spec → validate → compile to GLB
principles: The spec is the creature — joints/chains/volumes/parts/anims as JSON
volumes + parts are the structural floor; everything else sharpens
build:rigid for robots and crystals, default for flesh
role presets set budget and thresholds — boss costs more

cards.label: Music (audio_cpp)
cards.description: audio.cpp music lane — ACE-Step 1.5 XL / SFT or MiniMax Music 3 text-to-music (the audio_cpp binding layer calls audiocpp_cli with the family + model name from each model row)
principles: family + model is the audiocpp_cli invocation pair — pick by intent, not by parameter
XL is the flagship (bf16, best quality); SFT is the finetune (q8, lighter VRAM); txt2music is lyrics-aware
duration is the target length in seconds (default 120); sample_rate defaults to 44.1kHz
prompt is the music caption (genre/era/tempos/instruments); lyrics is the lyric block (txt2music only)

cards.label: Quad Remesh
principles: target_quads is the budget — lower is cleaner, higher keeps detail
sharp_edge below 90 preserves creases; above smooths them
adaptivity above 1 concentrates quads at curvature
Feed it a dense scan or TRELLIS output; it returns clean quads

cards.label: Text to Motion
principles: Describe MOTION, not pose — "walks forward, then crouches" beats "a person standing"
soma (30j) is the default; g1 (34j) for the Unitree rig; smplx (22j) is licence-gated
SMPL-X needs your own checkpoint (NVIDIA internal-R&D licence — no distribution)
Same seed + same prompt = same motion; seed -1 hashes the prompt
